scope: Aggregate QA results for Otzaria/otzaria#2476; contains no report contents, report identities, attachment data, database files or snapshots.
method: The test prepares dependencies outside isolation, then runs real form submission in a separate Linux network namespace with loopback only and no external routes. Real HttpClient/IOClient and Socket bypass Flutter HTTP mocking. A numeric TEST-NET socket target avoids DNS and returns real kernel ENETUNREACH before HTTP or TLS bytes can be delivered. Drafts and queued records are inspected before and after SQLite/store close/reopen.
limits: The UI is a Flutter Linux widget test, not a native desktop window or a Windows reproduction.
Restart means SQLite/store close and reopen within one test process; this evidence does not assert a whole-application process restart.
The real connection is intentionally redirected to a numeric TEST-NET destination inside the isolated namespace. DNS, TLS, production-server acceptance and actual delivery are not exercised.
The book library is a small synthetic fixture. These results apply to the exact product commit above.
This evidence does not establish Windows clipboard-history or Win+V behavior.
